## Classes

Company, Manager, Employee, Contractor

## Realtions

1) Employee

Works for Company, 1 to many. Aggregation.
Supervised by Manager, 1 to many.

2) Manager

Inherits from Employee.

3) Cotractor

Inherits from Employee.

4) Company

Employs Employee.

4) Company

private String name
private Employee employees
